summary: Interstate Power and Light Company (IPL), a subsidiary of Alliant Energy Corporation, filed a Form 8-K to report an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.100% Senior Debentures due 2031. The underwriters are Mizuho Securities USA LLC, PNC Capital Markets LLC, U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc., and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The offering closes on August 21, 2026, and is issued under an existing indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. This is a routine debt issuance under an automatic shelf registration, not a special situation.
